messages:
Alice Chen: @channel :rotating_light: Starting thread — were getting repeated tenant-health 5xx alerts for tenant 'BlueComms' over the last 9m. Multiple pages coming through. Alert: https://grafana.company/alert/9876

Marta Ruiz (monitoring-bot): Auto Incident INC-202303 created. payload: tenant=bluecomms, check=tenant-health, window=5m, 5xx_rate=6.8% (threshold=5%). No deploy tag detected in the timeframe.

Ravi Patel: Im on it. beginning triage: fetching LB logs, pod health, and RPC traces. ETA ~5m.

Sofia Gomez: Note BlueComms is marked high-priority & runs frequent hourly batches. Could be bursts. CS aware? @Jules Park?

Jules Park: CS pinged earlier privately — they saw transient errors ~15m ago, said they auto-retried. No formal ticket yet; Ill nudge them.

Ravi Patel: Ingress shows 500s mapping to model-service -> encoder v2 RPC timeouts. Errors look like `connection reset by peer` from encoder side across multiple pods. No pod restarts, CPU/memory normal. Network p99 slightly elevated.

Alice Chen: Can someone confirm user-facing errors vs synthetic check? Sofia, can CS quantify failed user requests in last 30m?

Sofia Gomez: Asking CS now. Meanwhile, do we want to silence the noisy pages for this tenant temporarily? Risk: miss real SLA breach.

Ravi Patel: Suggestion: mute tenant-health paging for BlueComms for 10m but keep Grafana alerts as INFO and create a human-owned ticket. That way we stop pages but keep telemetry.

Alice Chen: +1 to a short mute if we keep active monitoring and a ticket. Also add a dashboard widget showing customer errors/sec.

Marta Ruiz (monitoring-bot): Mute command available: `./scripts/mute_tenant_alert --tenant bluecomms --duration 10m --reason "investigating transient spike"`

Ravi Patel: Executed mute, confirmation MUTE-4821. Starting tcpdump on suspect nodes and tailing encoder logs. snippet: 
``
2025-03-14T01:22:11Z encoder v2 ERROR connection reset by peer
2025-03-14T01:22:11Z encoder v2 WARN retrying request (attempt 1)
```

Jules Park: CS replied: ~120 user requests failed across 2 endpoints in last 20m; retries mostly succeeded. CS wants updates in 30m.

Sofia Gomez: Dont extend mute past 10m without decision. Add BlueComms to a temporary watchlist for 6h so we can track without noisy pages for other tenants.

Alice Chen: Actions: Ravi = root cause triage (network vs service), Sofia = customer comms & watchlist, Jules = ticket for postmortem.

Ravi Patel: Found GC pauses in encoder v2 ~1.1s coincident with errors. Also noticed `encoder.pool_size` bumped to 48 in a config change yesterday. Might be heap pressure + GC.

Sofia Gomez: That pool_size change was deployed by infra. @Marco, can infra share the rollout notes?

Alice Chen: Marta, can you surface GC pause metrics in a temp dashboard panel for encoder pods? Prefer info-level correlate alert (no pages).

Marta Ruiz (monitoring-bot): Added `encoder.gc_pause` timeseries panel and correlate alert (severity=info). No paging. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/encoders/bluecomms-correlation

Jules Park: Opening ticket TKT-7132 to capture evidence, mute ids, and logs. Adding runbook checklist for post-incident tuning.

Ravi Patel: Mitigation: performing rolling restart of a canary subset of encoder v2 (3 pods) to clear potential heap fragmentation. Initiating now.

Alice Chen: Keep canary small and observe 5xx. If successful, proceed rolling restart. If not, we should revert `encoder.pool_size`. Who can rollback config? @Marco (infra oncall).

Marco (infra): I can revert `encoder.pool_size` and roll back yesterdays change if requested. Standby for go/no-go.

Ravi Patel: Canary restart complete for 3 pods. Observed 5xx drop to 0.8% within 2m post-restart. Promising signal.

Sofia Gomez: CS reports user errors subsided and latencies normalized. Sending update to customer: controlled restart and monitoring.

Alice Chen: Given improvement, extend mute for another 20m while we decide permanent fix. Plan: targeted rule tweak for tenant: increase 5m 5xx threshold to 7% (tenant-specific) and longer debounce, until we finish postmortem. This is adaptive tuning, not permanent weakening.

Ravi Patel: Ill open a monitoring-config PR: if tenant==bluecomms & window==5m -> alert.threshold=7% & debounce=8m. Linking PR when ready.

Marta Ruiz (monitoring-bot): Mute extended. New mute id MUTE-4821-EXT. Mute expiry +30m from thread start.

Jules Park: Post-incident checklist created: document root cause (encoder GC + `pool_size`), recommend rollback or GC tuning, add GC/heap dashboard, add tenant-specific rule & watchlist entry, update runbook for safe mute. Owners: Ravi, Marco, Marta, Sofia. Due: 24h.

Alice Chen: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with PR links and postmortem doc. Closing active paging coordination. :thumbsup: 

Ravi Patel: PR: https://git.company/monitoring/PR-4529 - contains rule tweak and notes. Will attach postmortem doc soon.

Sofia Gomez: CS notified and will escalate if they open a ticket. Moving conversation to post-incident review channel. :white_check_mark:
